items.title: A2UI surface
items.summary: Renders A2UI 1.0 surfaces with the installed ndigo-ui custom elements.

items.title: Accordion
items.summary: Expandable items with single/multiple and collapsible modes.

items.title: Alert
items.summary: Inline status message with info, success, warning, and danger variants.

items.title: App shell
items.summary: Responsive application frame with a skip link, banner, primary nav, sidebar, main landmark, and footer.

items.title: Aspect ratio
items.summary: Fixed-ratio media frame that reserves space before loading.

items.title: Badge
items.summary: Compact status label with neutral, accent, and semantic variants.

items.title: Breadcrumb
items.summary: Hierarchical page trail with links and a current-page marker.

items.title: Button
items.summary: Native-first button styles with variants and sizes; no runtime and no custom element.

items.title: Card
items.summary: Content surface with media, header, content, and footer parts.

items.title: Checkbox and radio
items.summary: Native checkboxes and radios with the brand accent, focus, and choice-group layout.

items.title: Code block
items.summary: Preformatted code surface with a language label, copy button, and nd-copy event.

items.title: Combobox
items.summary: Filterable single-select with an input, listbox, and filtered collection.

items.title: Command palette
items.summary: Modal command palette: a combobox inside a dialog, opened with Cmd/Ctrl+K.

items.title: Data table
items.summary: Sortable, selectable, paged table composed from the table, checkbox, button, and pagination items.

items.title: Date picker
items.summary: Popup calendar with an ISO form value, keyboard navigation, and min/max bounds.

items.title: Dialog
items.summary: Modal dialog with focus trapping, dismissal, and ARIA wiring from the Zag.js dialog machine.

items.title: Drawer
items.summary: Edge-anchored dialog with end, start, bottom, and top placement.

items.title: Field
items.summary: Label, help, and error scaffolding for native form controls.

items.title: File upload
items.summary: Dropzone with accept/size/count validation, a hidden file input, and a removable file list.

items.title: Input
items.summary: Native text inputs and textareas with focus, disabled, and invalid states.

items.title: Item
items.summary: List row with media, title, description, and trailing actions.

items.title: Keyboard key
items.summary: Key caps and keyboard chords for shortcut hints.

items.title: Ndigo element foundation
items.summary: Shared light-DOM custom-element base and the Zag.js machine controller.

items.title: Menu
items.summary: Dropdown menu with roving highlight, typeahead, and dismissal from the Zag.js menu machine.

items.title: Navigation menu
items.summary: Site navigation with dropdown content, hover/click triggers, and keyboard item navigation.

items.title: Pagination
items.summary: Native page navigation with links, a current-page state, ellipsis, and disabled edges.

items.title: Popover
items.summary: Non-modal overlay with a trigger, positioned surface, title/description, close, and arrow.

items.title: Scroll area
items.summary: Styled scrolling viewport with custom scrollbars, corner, and hover/drag states.

items.title: Select
items.summary: Single-select dropdown with a hidden native select and listbox options.

items.title: Separator
items.summary: Horizontal or vertical rule for grouping content.

items.title: Sidebar
items.summary: Sticky section navigation with native collapsible groups, active links, and a footer.

items.title: Skeleton
items.summary: Loading placeholder shapes with a reduced-motion-safe shimmer.

items.title: Slider
items.summary: Single-value range with track, range, thumb, and keyboard steps.

items.title: Spinner
items.summary: Rotating loading indicator with sizes and reduced-motion handling.

items.title: Switch
items.summary: Labelled toggle with a hidden checkbox and the ARIA switch contract.

items.title: Table
items.summary: Native tables with an overflow wrapper, sortable headers, numeric alignment, and row states.

items.title: Tabs
items.summary: Tablist, roving focus, arrow navigation, and tabpanels.

items.title: Tags input
items.summary: Removable tag chips with a hidden form value, max limit, paste parsing, and inline editing.

items.title: Ndigo theme
items.summary: Ndigo brand tokens (--nd-*) plus the opt-in base layer for native elements.

items.title: Toast
items.summary: Single transient notification with live-region semantics and auto-dismiss.

items.title: Tooltip
items.summary: Hint surface with hover/focus delays, arrow, and aria-describedby wiring.

items.title: Typography
items.summary: Scoped prose styles for rendered long-form content.
